author: Bijan Mousavi
title: Bound Git maintenance during disposable verification
why: The branch-head check failed while cleaning a temporary Git fixture; the integration check passed. Detached maintenance can outlive the checked Git command.
what: Run automatic maintenance and garbage collection without detaching in epoch and adapter processes.
how: Append command-scoped Git configuration while preserving inherited entries; reject invalid counts. Keep original historical tests and reports.
preserved: Original application, scientific content, runtime commands, locked dependencies and required checks.
risk: Foreground maintenance can increase a gate duration; existing timeouts remain enforced.
limitations: The exact Linux cleanup race was not reproduced locally. A forced automatic repack completed with all traced child exits. Independent corrected head and integration CI remain unrun at authoring.
rollback: Use an admitted reported revert of the environment helper, tests and documentation; retain original failure and process evidence.
